title: Chehlum karne aayi hai zainab
body:
CHEHLUM KARNE AAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
BHAAYI SE MILNE AAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
1. HOO KA MANZAR ZAINAB ASWS. TANHA.
JALTE QAIME ZAINAB ASWS. TANHA.
NANHE BACHE ZAINAB ASWS. TANHA.
<<MINI>>
AANKHO'N MEIN MANZAR LAAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. YAAD TUJHE KARTI THI SAKINA S.A.
SEENE PE SONE WAALI SAKINA S.A.
MARGAYI ZINDAA'N MEIN WO SAKINA S.A.
SAATH USE NA LAAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. LAAL PE TERE ZULM WO DHAAYE.
TOUQ E GIRAA'N AABID ASWS. KO PINHAYE.
SHIMR E LAYEE'N L.A. KAANTO'N PA CHALAAYE.
YEH BHI SITAM SEH AAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. IBNE ALI ASWS. THE AALE NABI THE.
SAR NANGE BAAZAR GAYE THE.
SAB YEH TAMASHA DEKH RAHE THE.
BAALO'N SE MOO KO DHAANPI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. BHAYI MERA ABBAS ASWS. NAHI HAIN.
BETA MERA AKBAR ASWS. BHI NAHI HAIN.
ISLIYE CHADAR SAR PE NAHI HAIN.
DEKHO KHULE SAR AAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. BHAIYYA HASSAN ASWS. KI BEWA KHADI HAIN.
IBNE HASSAN ASWS. KI BEWA KHADI HAI .
BAAP SE MILNE BETI KHADI HAIN.
<<MINI>>
AANKHO'N MEIN MANZAR LAAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. HUMKO GHUM ASGHAR ASWS. KA MILA HAIN.
ASGHARI WAALE SHUKR E QUDA JJH. HAIN.
MURTUZA AB KARBAL KO CHALA HAIN.
BHAYI SE KEHNE AAYI HAIN ZAINAB ASWS.
Kalaam: JANAB MURTUZA ALI SAHAB.
